title: Weekly Markets Monitor: A(I) reckoning
gist: World Gold Council weekly monitor: an AI-driven equity sell-off (Nvidia hit by an SEC probe report, Anthropic's record IPO fading) coincided with hawkish Fed minutes signalling a December hike and a sharp gold sell-off. WGC sees technicals pointing to a gold bounce but judges near-term risks roughly balanced given deleveraging, PCE and positioning risks.

insights.claim: Major global equity markets sold off in the week to 20 November 2026 on AI concerns, while bond yields rallied, oil prices eased further and the dollar ended the week higher.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Classic risk-off cross-asset pattern: AI-driven equity stress spilling into bonds and the dollar.
insights.quote: Equity markets sold off last week on the back of AI concerns.
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

insights.claim: Nvidia shares slumped despite strong earnings after fresh reports of an SEC accounting probe, signalling that good fundamentals no longer insulated AI leaders in November 2026.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Governance/regulatory headline risk is now overriding earnings beats in AI megacaps; watch for contagion across AI names.
insights.quote: Nvidia slumped despite strong earnings after fresh reports of an accounting probe by the SEC
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

insights.claim: Anthropic's record IPO gave back much of its debut gains during the November 2026 AI stock sell-off, a sign of fading appetite for AI new issuance.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Post-IPO fade in a flagship AI listing is a sentiment gauge for the AI equity cycle and future issuance.
insights.quote: Anthropic’s record IPO gave back much of its debut gains
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

themes.theme: Hawkish Fed and global macro data

insights.claim: Fed minutes released in November 2026 showed almost all officials expect to hike rates in December.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: A near-unanimous December hike bias is a headwind for non-yielding assets like gold and for duration-sensitive equities.
insights.quote: Fed minutes showed almost all officials expect to hike in December.
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

insights.claim: US data were mixed in mid-November 2026, with retail sales holding up while manufacturing missed expectations; Eurozone inflation hit a three-year high and UK inflation rose.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Resilient consumption plus rising European/UK inflation supports a hawkish global policy backdrop.
insights.quote: Eurozone inflation is at a three-year high
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

insights.claim: Japan's Q3 2026 GDP slipped on weak consumer data and China's October 2026 activity data came in weaker than expected, pointing to softening Asian growth.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Weak Asian growth adds to global demand concerns even as Western central banks lean hawkish.
insights.quote: Japan’s Q3 GDP slipped on weak consumer data
insights.locator: HighlightsEquity markets sold off last week

insights.claim: The World Gold Council judges gold's recent sell-off sharp enough to warrant a deeper dive, and says the technical picture suggests a bounce could be on the cards, with early signs of one already appearing on 23 November 2026.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Short-term tactical bounce setup in gold after a sharp sell-off, but WGC flags uncertain durability.
insights.quote: the technical picture suggests a bounce could be on the cards (C.O.T.W), and we’re seeing the early innings this morning. But how long it lasts is anyone’s guess.

insights.claim: Risks to gold are roughly balanced near term because of possible further pressure on leveraged equity/credit positions if the AI stock rout continues (forcing liquidations), further rotation into bonds, hawkish Fed minutes, a potential upside PCE surprise, and no clear positioning flush-out yet.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Checklist of gold downside catalysts to monitor: AI-rout deleveraging, PCE print, Fed path, and whether speculative positioning has fully cleared.
insights.quote: the absence, so far, of a clear positioning flush-out leave risks to gold roughly balanced over the coming days

insights.claim: Continued AI equity weakness could hurt gold indirectly by pressuring leveraged equity and credit positions, implying gold can be sold to meet margin needs during a risk-off deleveraging.
insights.speaker: @goldcouncil
insights.so_what: Gold is not a guaranteed hedge in an AI-led crash; deleveraging can drag it lower before any haven bid.
insights.quote: Further pressure on leveraged equity/credit positions should the AI stock rout continue
